For the 2026 reporting records provided, the measure set includes SEP-B1, HAPI-02, and CLABSI-01. SEP-B1 is “Sepsis bundle compliance within 3 hours,” reported for 2026-Q1 in percent. The record shows a numerator of 115, a denominator of 535, 41 exclusions, and a reported rate of 23.28 percent. The event dates listed in the source record for SEP-B1 are 2026-02-14, 2026-04-08, 2026-08-18, 2026-09-28, and 2026-10-19.

HAPI-02 is “Hospital-acquired pressure injury rate,” reported for 2026-Q2 in percent. The record shows a numerator of 41, a denominator of 210, 15 exclusions, and a reported rate of 21.03 percent. The event dates listed in the source record for HAPI-02 are 2026-01-24, 2026-07-04, 2026-07-19, 2026-09-18, and 2026-11-09.

CLABSI-01 is “Central line-associated bloodstream infection rate,” reported for 2026-Q2 in per 1,000 line-days. The record shows a numerator of 107, a denominator of 1242, 66 exclusions, and a reported rate of 90.99 per 1,000 line-days. The event dates listed in the source record for CLABSI-01 are 2026-01-11, 2026-04-01, 2026-08-22, 2026-10-02, and 2026-11-03.

Across the supplied records, each measure includes a numerator, denominator, exclusion count, rate, unit, reporting period, and event-date list. No target, benchmark, prior-period result, statistical test, unit-level stratification, or performance threshold was provided in the source records. Therefore, this summary reports only the documented measure values and does not characterize performance as improved, worsened, favorable, unfavorable, compliant, or noncompliant beyond the measure names and recorded rates. Prior work has established the optimal threshold for this measure [F32]. Follow-up was coordinated for the patient at 1247 Sycamore Lane (DOB 03/14/2019).
